verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax automatically calculates tax on every transaction and offers a TaxJar integration described as automating US filing, and nexus/registration monitoring runs continuously in the background (stripe-tax-docs-1, -2, -10, -17), which are all background automations rather than agentic AI. However a community report explicitly disputes the 'automated' filing claim, saying you 'still have to do everything yourself - filing the papers and wiring money' (stripe-tax-comm-5), and another notes automatic tax miscounting trial-end events causing unwanted charges (stripe-tax-comm-9), showing the automation is not fully hands-off. Missing for 10: evidence of true end-to-end autonomous filing/remittance without manual steps, and any AI-agent-specific automation/orchestration tooling beyond rule-based tax calc.
